entities.summary: Pompey, a notable figure in the history of Israel, associated with Second Temple Period (63 BCE–70). Preceded by Roman legions under Titus destroy the Second Temple in Jerusalem (70 AD) and Herod the Great massively expands the Second Temple complex (c. 20 BC). Their legacy influenced Bar Kokhba revolt — last major Jewish uprising against Rome.
